about.heading: About
about.title: Dataverse Docent v{version}
about.blurb: Desktop assistant for curating Dataverse datasets: discover drafts, approve downloads, run format checks, verify metadata, compare versions, and record decisions — all against the Dataverse Native/Search API with an API token. No direct database access; downloads, reports, and metadata caches live under your workspace.
about.bullets:
• Dashboard of datasets in review with status, label, and collection filters
• Per-file format checks (20 engines) plus dataset-level findings
• Metadata check profiles and published-vs-draft comparison
• Per-dataset timeline: versions, curation labels, local actions
• Headless mode: python main.py --headless <dir>
about.copy_tip: Version + environment facts for a support request (never the API token)

dialogs.generic_error: Something went wrong. The technical details are below.

network.unreachable: Could not reach the Dataverse server. Check your network connection or the Base URL in Settings (Ctrl+,), then try again.
network.timeout: The Dataverse server did not respond in time. It may be busy — try again in a moment.
network.guestbook_rejected: Dataverse rejected the guestbook answers. Fill in every required field (including any account field the server asks for), then try again.
network.guestbook_missing: This dataset requires a Guestbook response, but the download window did not have its fields. Reload the dataset metadata and try again — the download window will show the guestbook form.
network.auth: Dataverse rejected the request — the API token may be missing, expired, or lacking access. Update it in Settings (Ctrl+,), then try again.
network.not_found: The Dataverse URL or collection looks wrong (404). Check the Base URL and collection alias in Settings (Ctrl+,).
network.ssl: The secure connection to the Dataverse failed (certificate/SSL error). Check the Base URL, or ask IT about the server certificate.
